# NewsAPI Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill with read-only access to the news: top headlines by country and full-text search across news articles. It only reads news — it never writes, modifies, or sends anything. Free tier: 100 requests/day (development use), so the skill keeps limits small. Draft: written from NewsAPI's public docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
